title: ISic002134. Funerary marker for Philoxenos
body:
Text encoding: Jonathan Prag; edition source: https://www.zotero.org/groups/382445/items/4MCP2PVV
1Φιλόξενε
2χρηστὲ χαῖρε

Text encoding: Jonathan Prag; edition source: https://www.zotero.org/groups/382445/items/4MCP2PVV
1ΦΙΛΟΞΕΝΕ
2ΧΡΗΣΤΕΧΑΙΡΕ

Facsimile Images

Apparatus criticus

  • Text after Orsi 1912, 1915 and inventory;
  • 1: Orsi 1912: ΧΡΗΤ (sic); corrected in inventory and 1915

English translation

Jonathan Prag

Farewell, worthy Philoxenos!

commentary

The text was inadvertently published twice by Orsi in the NSA; the sigma is inserted subsequently in the transcription in the inventory, and clearly was omitted in the first transcription and the initial publication. The stone has not yet been located in the museum.

bibliography

  • Orsi NSA 1912 299 https://biblio.inscriptiones.org/epig10001392
  • Orsi NSA 1915 203 https://biblio.inscriptiones.org/epig10001392

Described as roughly engraved, but with no clear indication of the letter forms (although open sigma is implied)
